thread:
julia: Hey team, quick creative ops sync for next week's product launch. Need a consolidated spec for all visual assets (social, webinar deck, two benchmark diagrams). Can design confirm scope + timeline?

rebecca: We can handle — want the list of exact sizes, copy lock, and any tracking/lead-routing params. Also confirm if we should build localized decks.

devin: Copy lock (final):
- Headline: "Redwood Inference — consistent, predictable LLM serving"
- Subhead: "One API. Hosted, Dedicated, Private. Better latency and unit economics."
- CTA: "Register: redwood.ai/launch?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=launch_q2"

nik: For lead routing include: utm_medium={platform}, utm_source=social, utm_campaign=launch_q2. Add ?src=organic or ?src=paid as appropriate.

rebecca: Proposed deliverables: 
- Social: 1200x628 (preview), 1080x1080, 1920x1080 hero
- LinkedIn carousel: three 1080x1080 slides (why, how, demo)
- Webinar: master .pptx + Figma file, speaker slide, agenda slide, customer checklist slide for engineers
- Benchmarks: two diagram styles: "clean" (marketing) and "annotated" (technical), export in light/dark + SVGs
- Export packages: PNG/JPG/SVG + alt text sheet

rebecca: Naming: redwood_launch_{asset}_{size}_{theme}.png

julia: Add accessibility requirement: AA contrast report for each image and alt text drafts. Also need a simplified one-slide cost vs latency visual for the deck (marketing friendly).

rebecca: We'll run colors through contrast checker and include screenshots. We'll build the cost/latency slide from the numbers you drop.

devin: Uploading the raw benchmark CSVs + a short notes doc with messaging pointers to the drive: https://drive.redwood/release_assets/launch-benchmarks (internal)

rebecca: Good — we'll recreate charts as vectors in Figma, keep data identical, and provide both labeled (annotated) and simplified versions for PR/social.

nik: Timeline constraints: thumbnails by Mon 09:00, review Tue AM, final assets Wed EOD. If any design needs more time, flag immediately — marketing runbook is tied to Wed send.

rebecca: A couple of product questions: do we have an approved hero illustration or should design craft a new one? Also any legal checks on claims in the subhead?

julia: No approved illustration yet — design can create a simple abstract hero that matches brand shapes. Legal already cleared the headline/subhead, but keep benchmark statements precise and avoid absolute % claims without attribution.

art-bot: Task created: JIRA-8812 "Launch creative: social + deck + benchmark visuals" assigned to @rebecca, due 2026-03-26. :rocket:

rebecca: We'll include a one-slide integration checklist (supported runtimes, SDK links, private deploy notes) in the deck. Also will add an assets README with export filenames, alt text, and CTA links.

devin: One more ask: include UTM templates in a tiny JSON snippet in the README so growth can auto-append parameters for different channels. Example: { "utm_source": "social", "utm_medium": "{platform}", "utm_campaign": "launch_q2" }

rebecca: Perfect. We'll post thumbnails Monday and ping for review. If anything blocks, I'll escalate here.

julia: Thanks! Let's keep localization for a follow-up sprint — EN only for now.

nik: Appreciated — team's on a tight schedule, cheers everyone.
